title.narrative: Gender Equality Asia Regional

description.narrative: Mondiaal FNV aims at gender equality and safety at work as well as a workplace free of violence and harassment. For this aim, we follow four tracks: (1) Strengthening the position of women within the trade union movement. (2) Form alliances with civil society organisations. (3) Put pressure on employers. (4) Persuade governments. We urge ratification of ILO Convention C190 together with the development of legislation based on it.
